rules.rationale: Oxide anions carried the largest positive lift in development; oxygen's high polarizability raises phonon DOS peaks.
Moderate concentration balances polarizability and bonding complexity, matching the strongest observed candidates.
Mid mean Z covers oxides and moderately concentrated compositions.
Lanthanides were absent from the top candidates; f-electron contributions complicate phonon spectra.

skill.hypothesis: Transfers oxide polarizability and moderate concentration from the strongest development candidates; fails if lanthanide-free oxides saturate early.

model_lesson: The chalcogenide transfer failed: chalcogenide and post-transition candidates scored poorly, while the highest values came from lanthanide-free oxides. Development lifts and matched-rule evidence point to oxide polarizability and moderate concentration as the validated mechanisms.
